script: Every Japanese army officer in World War Two was required to carry a sword into battle, against rifles and machine guns. The Shin Gunto sword was mass produced fast, with none of the skill of a real samurai blade. It couldn't stop a bullet, and everyone carrying one knew it. The military kept requiring it anyway, purely to connect soldiers to the legend of the samurai. Every Japanese officer carried a sword into gunfire, purely to feel like a legend.

description:
Every Japanese army officer in WWII was required to carry a Shin Gunto sword into battle. Mass produced and useless against modern weapons, it existed purely to connect soldiers to the samurai legend.

Would you have carried it anyway, or refused? Let me know in the comments.
